rule: Time of day is only the device-clock flag on the surface scene (day for hours 8 to 19 inclusive). It drives star count, cloud drift sign and brightness pairs, never gameplay. In the dungeon, light is a sight number: level default (8, or 2 under Darkness), times 5/8 on dark feelings, capped at 26 minus depth on Halls, and floored at 6 while a torch Light buff (250 turns) is active; detaching restores level sight. Gas fields (weather-like) diffuse by neighbour average minus 1 per step with a fixed per-cell interaction order (fire cleared first, inferno cancels blizzard, otherwise freeze twice).
keep: Single sight number with a max floor from a timed light buff, reset on expiry
Dark-level sight as a ratio, not a separate mode
Depth cap on sight as a zone data field
Sign flip of drift and star field fading to the horizon as the one-glance time cue
Fixed per-cell interaction order for hazard fields
change: Device local clock removed: day flag must come from the server zone state
Turns become server ticks; buff expiry handled by the server tick, not the client
Hazard field per arena grid only, sized to the per-tick budget (parity row 18)
No sound tied to time of day exists in the donor; add one only by design, not by copying
